item.title: Cache Tech Community Meetup - October 2026
item.description: Join us on Saturday, October 24th, 2026, from 1:30 PM to 3:30 PM for a tour of the Logan Library’s Cytiva STEM Makerspace, 285 N Main, Logan, UT 84321. Discover tools for 3D printing, laser cutting, crafting, and digitizing media while connecting with Cache Valley’s tech community. All skill levels are welcome!
